_meta.description: ZH override map for post-BLP curation. Each entry replaces the noisy DOJ glossary zh_clean with a canonical HK Cap. legal lemma so that corpus matching (build_postBLP_contexts.py) can find post-1989 attestations. Entries are keyed by (domain, en) and applied as overlay on legal_terms.json without mutating the upstream Firthian dataset.
_meta.rationale: 104/408 KEEP terms in postBLP_curation_longlist.csv have k_zh < 4 in post-1989 sections because the DOJ-glossary zh_clean is a phrasal/wrong-sense form that does not occur verbatim in HK Cap. e-Legislation. This file lists my proposed canonical lemma per term, with back-translation, so the user (non-ZH-reader) can audit each decision on legal-sense grounds.

policy_levels.HIGH: DOJ phrase contains the canonical short lemma; override extracts it. Low-risk.
policy_levels.MEDIUM: Multiple canonical candidates; I picked the most frequent in HK Cap. usage with back-translation disclosed.
policy_levels.ASK: Genuinely ambiguous between two senses with different legal scope; user decision needed.
policy_levels.DROP: EN side fails post-BLP K>=4 OR no canonical ZH form viable; remove from core.

value.zh_original: DOJ-glossary form currently in legal_terms.json zh_clean
value.zh_override: the canonical HK Cap. lemma proposed
value.rationale: why this lemma is canonical for the EN sense

civil|patent.rationale: Reviewer 2 (US common-law native, 2026-05-10) flagged that demoting 'patent' was a substantive loss of major IP/civil canon. The DOJ entry was wrong-sense (= adjective 'obvious'). The IP-canonical lemma in HK Cap. (esp. Cap.514 Patents Ordinance) is 專利. Manual override rescues the term for the post-BLP core.

constitutional|bill.rationale: Reviewer 2 (US common-law native) flagged 'bill' as constitutional canon (bill of rights, money bill, public bill, private member's bill). DOJ entry was wrong-sense (= payment receipt). HK Cap. canonical for legislative bill is 法案 (e.g., 草案 also for draft bill, but 法案 dominant).

international|international law.rationale: Reviewer 2 (US common-law native) flagged demotion as eponymous-bin loss. DOJ glossed with 國際私法 (private international law / conflicts), narrowing scope. Generic 'international law' = 國際法 (public international law, the standard English-language sense).

criminal|assault.rationale: Reviewer 2 (US common-law native) flagged that 'assault' is a common-law substantive criminal canon. DOJ over-narrowed to 猥褻侵犯 (indecent assault, sex-offence-specific). The general assault lemma in HK Cap. (Cap.212 Offences against Person, also amendments) is 襲擊.

labor_social|occupational.rationale: Reviewer 2 (US common-law native) flagged demotion of labor-canon term. DOJ entry was wrong-sense (= CV/employment history). The labour-law canonical adjective 'occupational' (occupational safety/health/disease) is 職業 (Cap.59 Occupational Safety etc.). Note: this collides with vocational→職業; reviewer-2 also flagged this. Mitigation: 'vocational' previously already used 職業; consider future split if encoder collision arises.

administrative|approval.rationale: 批函 is the document of approval; 批准 is the act/decision lemma used throughout HK Cap. permits/licensing.

administrative|governing.rationale: Lemma extraction; 規管 is the canonical adjective/verb in HK Cap.

administrative|registry.rationale: Lemma extraction; 登記處 is the generic registry lemma.

administrative|Registrar.rationale: DOJ entry is a specific officer title; 登記官 is generic Registrar across HK Cap. Alternative 註冊官 is also valid for company registrar; 登記官 covers more domains.

civil|deposit.rationale: Lemma extraction; 按金 is HK Cap. canonical.

civil|estate.rationale: 估算 between 產業 (general estate / holding), 遺產 (deceased's estate), 不動產 (real property). 產業 is dominant in HK Cap. property law for civil-domain estate.

civil|infringement.rationale: Reviewer 1 (HK legal-Chinese native) flagged that 侵犯 in HK Cap. predominantly carries physical/personal sense (侵犯人身, 侵犯私隱). The IP-infringement canonical standalone is 侵權 (Cap.528 Copyright, Cap.559 Trade Marks). Revised override: 侵權.

civil|insolvency.zh_original: 針對無力償債的法律程序
civil|insolvency.rationale: Lemma is 無力償債 (the state of insolvency); 破產 is bankruptcy specifically. HK Cap. distinguishes.

civil|ownership.rationale: Lemma extraction; 擁有權 generic in HK Cap.

civil|provision.rationale: Lemma extraction; 條款 = legal-instrument provision.

civil|unincorporated.rationale: HK Cap. canonical compound 非法團 dominant for unincorporated bodies.

civil|trade mark.rationale: Lemma extraction; 商標 is the IP canonical.

civil|gift.rationale: Form is correct (no override). Low coverage (k_zh=1) reflects that 贈與 is rare in post-1989 HK Cap. text. Accept and document.

civil|contractor.rationale: Form correct, k_zh=2 marginal but acceptable; 承建商 is alternative for construction-context contractor. Accept current.

civil|partnership.rationale: Lemma extraction; 合夥 = partnership in HK Cap.

constitutional|delegate.zh_orig_backtranslation: person to whom power has been sub-delegated
constitutional|delegate.rationale: DOJ phrase carries 'sub-delegation' nuance. 獲授權人 is the canonical 'delegate' in HK Cap. delegation contexts. Alternative 受權人.

constitutional|quorum.zh_orig_backtranslation: Justice of the Peace warrant of appointment
constitutional|quorum.rationale: DOJ entry is wrong-sense entirely. 法定人數 is the unambiguous Cap. lemma for quorum across legislative-procedural contexts.

constitutional|organization.zh_orig_backtranslation: organization that is not a corporate body

constitutional|system.rationale: 制度 (institution/system) vs 體系 (system/framework). 制度 is more frequent in HK Cap. for institutional/political 'system'.

constitutional|assembly.rationale: Lemma extraction; ellipsis in DOJ phrase signals embedded canonical form 集會.

constitutional|elect.zh_orig_backtranslation: elect not to give evidence (criminal procedure)
constitutional|elect.rationale: DOJ entry is the wrong sense (criminal-procedure 'elect not to'). The constitutional sense is 選舉 (electoral). Alternative 選任 (to appoint by election). 選舉 is dominant.

constitutional|incorporation.rationale: Lemma extraction. 法團 = body corporate. The act of incorporation is 註冊成立; 法團 is the resulting entity. For embedding-space, 法團 better captures the legal-canon meaning.

constitutional|president.rationale: User decision 2026-05-10: 'president' = head of state. First override 總統 (foreign-president sense) yielded k_zh=0. Switching to 行政長官 (HK Chief Executive), the constitutional head of HK SAR. Pervasive in post-1989 Cap. (Basic Law-derived offices, executive functions). Conceptually distinct from foreign presidents but the closest HK-specific head-of-state lemma.

constitutional|society.rationale: Lemma extraction; 社團 = registered society in HK Cap.

constitutional|Presiding Officer.rationale: DOJ entry too narrow. In legislative/electoral context, 主持 captures 'presiding officer' role. Alternative 主席 conflicts with 'chairman'.

constitutional|Council.rationale: User decision 2026-05-10: drop 'Council' from constitutional core to avoid quasi-duplicate with 'Legislative Council' (already AUTO_KEEP). Council is too poly-sense to encode cleanly.

constitutional|constitution.rationale: Form correct. k_zh=2 reflects that 憲法 is rare in HK Cap. text post-1989 because HK has the Basic Law (《基本法》), not a constitution. This is a corpus property, document in §2.2.

constitutional|Director.rationale: DOJ entry overspecific. 署長 is the canonical 'Director' of a department in HK Cap. governmental hierarchy.

constitutional|election.rationale: DOJ entry wrong-sense (selection/interview, not electoral). 選舉 is unambiguous canonical.

criminal|imprisonment.rationale: 監禁 is the unambiguous Cap. lemma for 'imprisonment as sentence'. 禁錮 is alternative but narrower.

criminal|prosecution.zh_orig_backtranslation: burden of proof rests on the prosecution
criminal|prosecution.rationale: 檢控 = act of prosecuting; 控方 = prosecution side; 公訴 = public prosecution. 檢控 is dominant in HK Cap. for 'prosecution' as a noun describing the legal action.

criminal|culpable.rationale: Even with the override 應受懲處, k_zh=0. 'Culpable' in HK Cap. mostly appears as part of 'culpable homicide' = 誤殺 (which is 'manslaughter', collisions with 'murder' encoding). No clean canonical lemma in HK Cap. post-1989. Drop from core.

criminal|defraud.rationale: 詐取 (=obtain by fraud, transitive verb) is correct but rare. 欺詐 is the noun/general lemma covering fraud. HK Cap. uses 欺詐 more frequently.

criminal|forfeiture.zh_original: 對租契所設租賃權的沒收
criminal|forfeiture.zh_orig_backtranslation: forfeiture of leasehold rights under a lease

criminal|guilty.rationale: Lemma normalisation; 有罪 is the verdict-form canonical.

criminal|indecent.rationale: First override 猥褻 yielded k_zh=0 because 猥褻 mostly appears in pre-1989 Crimes Ordinance. Switching to 不雅 (used in post-1989 Control of Obscene and Indecent Articles Ord., Cap. 390) which dominates post-BLP indecent-publications regime.

criminal|juvenile.rationale: Lemma extraction. 少年 covers juvenile across HK Cap.

criminal|misconduct.rationale: 失當行為 is the canonical compound; 行為失當 is also valid but flips word order. 失當行為 dominant in HK Cap.

criminal|plea.rationale: 答辯 is the canonical procedural lemma in HK Cap.

criminal|offence.rationale: 罪行 is the dominant offence-noun in HK Cap. (vs 罪 alone, vs 犯罪 = act of committing).

criminal|crime.rationale: Reviewer 1 (HK legal-Chinese native, 2026-05-10) flagged that mapping both crime AND offence to 罪行 creates an encoding collision distorting RSA. Revised: crime → 犯罪 (act of committing crime / criminal act), offence → 罪行. The two will remain neighbours in embedding space but not collapse.

criminal|offender.rationale: Lemma generalisation; 罪犯 is offender lemma.

criminal|attempt.zh_orig_backtranslation: attempt to escape from lawful custody

criminal|criminal.rationale: Lemma extraction; 刑事 is the canonical adjective in HK Cap.

criminal|detention.rationale: 拘留 is HK Cap. canonical for police/administrative detention. 拘押 alternative.

criminal|sentence.zh_original: 將……的判刑與……的量刑基準掛鈎
criminal|sentence.zh_orig_backtranslation: to link the sentence of X to the sentencing benchmark of Y
criminal|sentence.rationale: Lemma extraction; 判刑 is the canonical (vs 量刑 = sentencing process).

criminal|trafficking.rationale: First override 販運 yielded k_zh=2 (just below K=4 strict). 販毒 alt is too narrow (drug-only). 人口販運 (human trafficking) is its own multi-term. Accept k_zh=2 as marginal, document in §2.1; the few attestations are still post-BLP and bilingually paired.

criminal|unlawfully.rationale: Lemma extraction; 非法 is HK Cap. adjective/adverb canonical.

international|protocol.rationale: 議定書 is canonical for 'protocol' as an international-law instrument; the DOJ entry confused it with 'draft'.

international|association.rationale: 協會 dominant for international association in HK Cap.; 組織 too generic.

international|related.zh_original: 與結果有關的收費架構
international|related.rationale: 有關 is the dominant 'related' modifier in HK Cap. (more frequent than 相關).

international|independent.rationale: Lemma; 獨立 dominant in HK Cap.

international|military.rationale: Form correct. k_zh=2 reflects HK Cap. has limited military legislation post-1989 (defence is PRC matter under Basic Law). Document.

international|non-Hong Kong.rationale: Lemma extraction. HK Cap. uses 非香港 prefix consistently for foreign entities.

international|conference.rationale: Lemma extraction; 會議 is the canonical.

international|People's Republic of China.rationale: EN-side fail (k_en=0): the corpus rarely uses the full English name; usually 'PRC' or 'Mainland'. Drop from core; document as a corpus property of HK Cap. (the term Hong Kong refers to is 'the Mainland' or geographical descriptors, not the formal state name).

international|World Trade Organisation.rationale: EN-side fail (k_en=1). The acronym 'WTO' is more common; HK Cap. rarely uses the full English form post-1989 outside one Ordinance. Drop.

labor_social|labour.rationale: 勞工 is the lemma for 'labour' (worker / labour force) in HK Cap. (e.g. Labour Department = 勞工處). 勞資 covers labour-management relations specifically.

labor_social|account.rationale: 帳戶 is the canonical 'account' (the entity); 帳號 is the identifier. HK Cap. uses 帳戶 for accounts in financial regulation.

labor_social|gratuity.rationale: 酬金 generic; 約滿酬金 specific to contract-end. The generic lemma 酬金 broader for embedding-space.

labor_social|staff.rationale: 員工 is the dominant 'staff' lemma in HK Cap. employment context.

labor_social|full-time.rationale: 全職 is the standard HK Cap. lemma for 'full-time' employment.

labor_social|level.rationale: Lemma extraction; the DOJ entry was sentencing-domain, but the labor_social lemma 'level' = 等級 generic.

labor_social|position.rationale: 職位 is the canonical 'job position' in HK Cap. employment.

labor_social|winding up.rationale: 清盤 generic; 強制清盤 specific to compulsory.

labor_social|vocational.rationale: Reviewer 2 (US common-law native) prioritised 'occupational' as labor-canon (rescued from AUTO_KEEP_DROP via override 職業). Both 'vocational' and 'occupational' would collide on 職業 in ZH (no clean lexical distinction in HK Cap. ZH). Drop 'vocational' (kzh=2 marginal, semantically subsumed by occupational) to avoid encoder duplication.

procedure|appeal.rationale: Lemma extraction; 上訴 is the canonical procedural lemma.

procedure|arbitration.zh_orig_backtranslation: to submit disputed matters to arbitration

procedure|audit.rationale: Lemma extraction; 審核 generic in HK Cap.

procedure|beyond reasonable doubt.zh_orig_backtranslation: prove the case without reasonable doubt
procedure|beyond reasonable doubt.rationale: First override 毫無合理疑點 yielded k_zh=0 (set phrase too rare in exact form). Switch to substring 合理疑點 which appears across HK Cap. embedded in any of: 毫無/無/超越/排除…合理疑點. Captures the doctrinal lemma.

procedure|claim.rationale: Lemma extraction; 申索 = procedural claim in HK Cap.

procedure|court.rationale: Reviewer 1 (HK legal-Chinese native) flagged that the original choice 法庭 was reversed: in HK Cap. post-1989, 法院 is the canonical institutional lemma (高等法院, 區域法院, 終審法院, 原訟法庭 sits within 高等法院). 法庭 = tribunal / 'in-court' venue / Court of Appeal exception. For the procedural-domain term encoding 'court as institution', revised override: 法院.

procedure|fine.zh_original: 關於罰款及擔保的法院紀錄
procedure|fine.zh_orig_backtranslation: court records concerning fines and securities

procedure|issue.zh_original: 共同提出爭論點供裁決
procedure|issue.zh_orig_backtranslation: jointly raise points of dispute for determination

procedure|serve.zh_orig_backtranslation: need not be served on any party
procedure|serve.rationale: Lemma extraction; 送達 is the canonical procedural service-of-process verb.

procedure|substantiate.rationale: 證實 is the canonical 'substantiate' (prove with evidence). 提供事實 is too literal/loose.

procedure|witness.zh_orig_backtranslation: duly signed or executed as witness (attestation phrase)
procedure|witness.rationale: DOJ entry is the attestation-formula sense. 證人 is the procedural 'witness' (testifying person).

procedure|proceeding.zh_original: 循簡易程序審訊藐視法庭案
procedure|proceeding.zh_orig_backtranslation: summary trial of contempt of court
procedure|proceeding.rationale: 法律程序 is the canonical compound for 'legal proceedings' in HK Cap. — distinct from 程序 alone (= 'procedure', overlap with 'process').

procedure|informed.zh_original: 知情和有理可依的裁決
procedure|informed.rationale: Lemma extraction. 知情 is HK Cap. canonical for 'informed' (state of being informed).

procedure|available.zh_override_backtranslation: available (canonical: 可供查閱 / 可供使用)
procedure|available.rationale: Reviewer 1 (HK legal-Chinese native) flagged that 可獲得 is a verbal phrase, not a lexicalised legal lemma. HK Cap. canonical for 'available' is 可供 in compound forms 可供查閱 (available for inspection), 可供使用 (available for use). EN samples confirm 'available for inspection by the public' contexts. Revised override: 可供.

procedure|bona fide.rationale: Form correct. k_zh=3 marginally below K=4. Accept (or push to MEDIUM via expanding to 真誠 alternative). Going with ACCEPT to avoid wrong-sense risk.

procedure|process.rationale: User decision 2026-05-10: disambiguate from 'proceeding'. process → 程序 (short lemma); proceeding → 法律程序 (compound). Distinct encodings preserve both terms in the core.

criminal|intimidate.rationale: EN-side fail (k_en=2): 'intimidate' as verb is rare post-1989 in EN. The noun 'intimidation' covers same concept and is already AUTO_KEEP in criminal. Drop verb form to avoid duplication.

criminal|counterfeit.rationale: BOTH-side fail (k_en=0, k_zh=0). The DOJ phrase is too narrow and the EN form 'counterfeit' is rare in HK Cap. post-1989 (only currency contexts; mostly handled via Crimes Ord. provisions whose lemma is 偽造).

criminal|convict.zh_orig_backtranslation: to determine guilt / to find guilty
criminal|convict.rationale: BOTH-side fail (k_en=1, k_zh=1). 'convict' as a verb is rare post-1989 in both langs; 'conviction' (noun) is already AUTO_KEEP. Drop to avoid duplication and weak coverage.
